Fasteners Manufacturer in India: Bolts, Nuts, Screws, Washers & Cotter Pins

Sharma Technocast is an ISO 9001:2015 certified fasteners manufacturer in Ahmedabad, India. We make bolts, nuts, screws, washers, spring lock washers, cotter pins, lock wire and nails in all general sizes, grades and coatings to IS, DIN, ISO and ASTM standards, or to your drawing. Parts are hot forged or cold forged, with threads rolled or cut to suit the part, and every batch is checked by proof load, hardness and tensile testing. Typical manufacturing lead time is 30 to 45 days, depending on quantity, for oil & gas, construction, automotive, heavy engineering and OEM customers across India and worldwide.
